descriptions.description: Speak Business English Like an American

exercises.title: Choose the most appropriate response to ech sentence:

question.text: 1. Did our CEO give the green light for the new project yet?

options.option: a) No, he told us he needed more information before making a decision.
b) Yes, he told us that the project was a bad idea and that we should stop working on it.
c) Yes, he's going to discuss the project with his wife and see what she thinks.

question.text: 2. Last year, our company made a loss on our new line of video games, but this year we'll break even.

options.option: a) I'm sorry to hear you're broke.
b) That's great. At least you're making progress.
c) Too bad. Last year you did a lot better.

question.text: 3. If you don't double-check those numbers and make sure they're correct, you might get in hot water with your boss.

options.option: a) You're right. My boss always appreciates it when I give him the wrong numbers.
b) That would be great. My boss enjoys soaking in hot water.
c) You're right. My boss always gets angry when he finds mistakes.

question.text: 4. Our company is in the red again this quarter.

options.option: a) Congratulations! When's the celebration party?
b) In the red again? I hope you don't go out of business!
c) In the red? That's okay. It's better than being in the black.

question.text: 5. We should pull the plug on our online advertising campaign.

options.option: a) I agree. It's not bringing us any new business.
b) I agree. Let's double our spending on it.
c) I disagree. I think we should stop spending money on online advertising.

question.text: 6. I know our company is looking for ways to cut costs. Do you think my head is on the chopping block?

options.option: a) No, don't worry. They won't fire you.
b) No, I don't think so. But you might get fired.
c) No, I don't think they'll cut off your head.

question.text: 7. Doesn't it blow your mind that they promoted Beth to General Manager after the mess she made in our department?

options.option: a) Yes, she really deserved that promotion.
b) No, but it does surprise me.
c) Yes, it really surprises me!

question.text: 8. Did you have a chance to crunch those numbers yet?

options.option: a) Yes, I put them in a blender and crunched them up.
b) Yes, I just put the financial reports on your desk.
c) Yes, I'll take a look at them next week.
